opening.argument: The presentation links participation in ONE Academy directly to acquiring an educational package bundled with tokens, then frames progression through its levels as a way to gain finance and trading knowledge and practice with ONE coin. It therefore promotes a combined education-and-token product, rather than merely discussing cryptocurrency in the abstract. The speaker expressly says, "Get your educational package along with tokens and combine your knowledge with practical experience," and promises tools to practice with ONE coin. The video does not state the package price, so no spoken price or specific financial loss is being claimed here.

citations.quote: Get your educational package along with tokens and combine your knowledge with practical experience.
As you progress up the knowledge ladder to level six, you will understand the theoretical foundation of finance and trading and also get the tools to practice your knowledge with ONE coin.
